The '''AA-1 VerboBrain''' was a model of [[Verbobrain/Legends|verbobrain]] manufactured by [[SyntheTech/Legends|SyntheTech]], that was installed in the [[3PO-series protocol droid/Legends|3PO series]] of [[Protocol droid/Legends|protocol droids]] produced by [[Cybot Galactica/Legends|Cybot Galactica]]. The AA-1 was designed to allow the [[Droid/Legends|droid]] to flawlessly perform as [[Translator/Legends|translators]] and [[Diplomat/Legends|diplomats]], and also allowed the unit to develop an original personality with genuine emotions.<ref name="EGTD" />

The AA-1 was a piece of computing hardware that enabled a droid's cognitive functions and logic processing. The fluency in "6 million forms of communication" C-3PO often boasted about was provided by a [[TranLang III communications module/Legends|TranLang III communications module]], not to be confused with the AA-1 Verbobrain. 

[[Industrial Automaton/Legends|Industrial Automaton]] installed AA-1 VerboBrains in the [[LOM-series protocol droid/Legends|LOM-series protocol droid]]. Equipping the trademark hardware infuriated [[Cybot Galactica/Legends|Cybot Galactica]], which was compounded by Industrial Automaton giving the LOM-series a [[TranLang III communications module/Legends|TranLang III communications module]] and obvious cosmetic similarities to the [[3PO-series protocol droid/Legends|3PO-series]]. Cybot Galactica sent an army of copyright [[Lawyer/Legends|attorneys]] after Industrial Automaton, leading to only a limited release of the LOM-series.<ref name="EGTD" />

The AA-1 had a total data capacity of five exabytes and could operate at seven petahertz.<ref name="MedStar II: Jedi Healer">''[[MedStar II: Jedi Healer]]''</ref>

[[PD-series protocol droid]]s were equipped with standard AA-1 VerboBrains. Due to the intention to sell the droids to the [[Lurrian]] market, sixty percent of the [[Language/Legends|language]] programming was removed and replaced with extensive information on genetics and DNA resequencing.<ref name="EGTD" />

The AA-1 VerboBrain was installed in [[Arakyd Industries/Legends|Arakyd Industries']] [[Mark VII "Inquisitor" Series Seeker Droid]]. It worked in conjunction with Arakyd's own [[BXT-4 central processing computer]].<ref name="EGWT">''[[The Essential Guide to Weapons and Technology]]''</ref>
